title: Far Beyond All That We Ask

request.style: English, deep male voice, solo, electric guitar, upright bass, drums, Hammond organ, melancholic, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Christ dwells in hearts through faith
Rooted and grounded in love
Power with saints to grasp
The wide and long and high and deep

[Chorus]
To Him who is able to do
Far beyond all that we ask or imagine
According to the power at work
Within us, glory be

[Verse]
Know the love that surpasses knowledge
Filled with the fullness of God
In the church and in Christ Jesus
Glory throughout all generations

[Chorus]
To Him who is able to do
Far beyond all that we ask or imagine
According to the power at work
Within us, glory be

[Bridge]
Forever and ever, Amen
Glory in the church and in Christ
Beyond our asking, beyond our sight
The power at work within us

[Chorus]
To Him who is able to do
Far beyond all that we ask or imagine
According to the power at work
Within us, glory be
